result.topic_en: Gauss sets up the differential equations and finite-difference relations for determining a comet's orbit from three observations, relating geocentric distances Δ, Δ', Δ'' to observed longitudes α, latitudes β and solar longitudes, with notation for the distances to Earth and Sun.
result.transcription:
Litt D

$\varrho$ Abstand des Cometen von der Erde
$\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial t}$ Geschwindigkeit der Bewegung auf der Kugelfläche
$\mu$ Mittl. Bew. der $\odot$ in einem Tage
R Abstand der Sonne von der Erd
r Abstand des Cometen von der Sonne

$0 = \frac{2\partial\varrho\partial\sigma^2 + \varrho\partial\sigma\partial\partial\sigma}{\partial t^3} + \mu\mu\left(\frac{1}{R^3}-\frac{1}{r^3}\right)\partial$ cosin dist. geocentr.[?] $\odot$ a cometa

$\frac{\cos\beta'}{2\varrho'}\left\{\frac{\sin(\alpha''-\alpha')^2\cos\beta''+\theta'\sin\beta''}{(t''-t')^2}\varrho''\varrho'' - \frac{\sin(\alpha'-\alpha)^2\cos\beta+\theta'\sin\beta}{(t'-t)^2}\varrho\varrho\right\}$
$= \mu\mu\left(\frac{1}{r^3}-\frac{1}{R^3}\right)R\left\{\cos(A'-\alpha'')\cos\beta''-\cos(A'-\alpha)\cos\beta\right\}$

Relationen
$0 = \Delta(u''-u')\sin(V'-\alpha) - \Delta'(u''-u)\sin(V'-\alpha') + \Delta''(u'-u)\sin(V'-\alpha'') + \frac{1}{2}(u'-u)(u''-u)(u''-u')\frac{\Delta'}{r'^3}\sin(V'-\alpha')$
$0 = \Delta(u''-u')\cos(V'-\alpha) - \Delta'(u''-u)\cos(V'-\alpha') + \Delta''(u'-u)\cos(V'-\alpha'') + \frac{1}{2}(u'-u)(u''-u)(u''-u')\left\{\frac{\Delta'}{r'^3}\cos(V'-\alpha')+R'\left(\frac{1}{R'^3}-\frac{1}{r'^3}\right)\right\}$
Hieraus
1) $0 = \Delta(u''-u')\cos(\alpha'-\alpha) - \Delta'(u''-u) + \Delta''(u'-u)\cos(\alpha''-\alpha') + \frac{1}{2}(u'-u)(u''-u)(u''-u')\left\{\frac{\Delta'}{r'^3}+R'\left(\frac{1}{R'^3}-\frac{1}{r'^3}\right)\cos(V'-\alpha')\right\}$
2) $0 = \Delta(u''-u')\sin(\alpha'-\alpha) - \Delta''(u'-u)\sin(\alpha''-\alpha') - \frac{1}{2}(u'-u)(u''-u)(u''-u')R'\left(\frac{1}{R'^3}-\frac{1}{r'^3}\right)\sin(V'-\alpha')$
ferner 3) $0 = \Delta(u''-u')$[-...-]{+$(\theta'\cos(\alpha'-\alpha)-\theta)$+}$ - \Delta''(u'-u)$[-...-]{+$(\theta''-\theta'\cos(\alpha''-\alpha'))$+}$ + \frac{1}{2}(u'-u)(u''-u)(u''-u')R'\left(\frac{1}{R'^3}-\frac{1}{r'^3}\right)\cos(V'-\alpha')\theta'$
Durch Verbindung dieser drei Gleichungen entstehen folgende
4) $0 = \Delta(u''-u')(\theta'\sin(V'-\alpha)-\theta\sin(V'-\alpha')) - \Delta''(u'-u)(\theta''\sin(V'-\alpha')-\theta'\sin(V'-\alpha''))$
5) [-0-] $\Delta'\left(1-\frac{1}{2}(u''-u')(u'-u)\frac{1}{r'^3}\right)(\theta\sin(\alpha''-\alpha')-\theta'\sin(\alpha''-\alpha)+\theta''\sin(\alpha'-\alpha)) = \frac{1}{2}R'(u''-u')(u'-u)\left\{\frac{1}{R'^3}-\frac{1}{r'^3}\right\}\times$
$\times(\theta''\sin(V'-\alpha)-\theta\sin(V'-\alpha''))$
6) $0 = \Delta(u''-u')\theta - \Delta'(u''-u)\theta' + \Delta''(u'-u)\theta'' + \frac{1}{2}(u'-u)(u''-u)(u''-u')\theta'\frac{\Delta}{r'^3}$.
